# Steelers select Johnson in third round

#  Steelers select Johnson in third round  
Apr 26, 2019 at 09:40 PM  
*   *   *   * Copied!  
**Diontae Johnson
Wide Receiver
Toledo
5-10, 183
Ruskin, Fla.
Lennard High School
3rd Round â 66th Overall**  
**CAREER NOTES**
Totaled 137 receptions for 2,276 yards and 24 touchdowns in 38 games played at Toledoâ¦ranks fifth in school history in touchdown receptionsâ¦returned 79 kickoffs (1,849 yards) for a 23.4 return average and two touchdowns and 17 punt returns (243 yards) with two return scores.  
**2018 SEASON**

# Steelers select Johnson in third round

**2018 SEASON**
Garnered MAC Special Teams Player of the Year honorsâ¦first-team All-MAC selection as a wide receiver and punt returner and second-team as a kickoff returnerâ¦led offense in receptions (43) and receiving yards (663) with seven touchdown catches, along with a punt return and kickoff return for a touchdownâ¦caught six passes for 119 yards and two touchdowns vs. Miami (Fla.) (Sept. 15), earning MAC West Offensive Player of the Week accoladesâ¦scored on a 98-yard kickoff return vs. Nevada (Sept. 22), adding four receptions for 67 yards and a touchdownâ¦hauled in an 80-yard touchdown catch vs. Buffalo (Oct. 20).  
**2017 SEASON**

# Steelers select Johnson in third round

Tabbed first-team All-MAC as a wide receiver and punt returner and second-team as a kickoff returnerâ¦hauled in 74 catches for a school-record 1,278 yards and 13 touchdowns, adding 683 kickoff return yardsâ¦averaged 148.0 all-purpose yards per game, most in the MAC and seventh in the nationâ¦scored on a 99-yard kickoff return in the season-opener vs. Elon (Aug. 31), catching four passes for 102 yardsâ¦registered 142 receiving yards and two touchdowns against Tulsa (Sept. 16)â¦added a second multiple touchdown performance, with two touchdown catches on eight receptions vs. Miami (Fla.) (Sept. 23)â¦amassed a career-high 170 receiving yards and two touchdowns at Ball State (Oct. 26), returning a punt 87 yards for a touchdown against the Cardinals, earning MAC West Special Teams Player of the Week honorsâ¦posted a career-high 10 catches vs. Northern Illinois for 166 yards, including a career-long 89-yard grab (Nov. 2)â¦had nine catches for 118 yards and two touchdowns in the MAC

# Steelers select Johnson in third round

of the Week honorsâ¦posted a career-high 10 catches vs. Northern Illinois for 166 yards, including a career-long 89-yard grab (Nov. 2)â¦had nine catches for 118 yards and two touchdowns in the MAC Championship game vs. Akron (Dec. 2).

# Steelers select Johnson in third round

**2016 SEASON**
Did not see action due to injuryâ¦Redshirt.  
**2015 SEASON**
Saw action in 11 games, making 14 receptions for 237 yards and three touchdownsâ¦returned 32 kickoffs for a 22.8 yards per return mark.  
**HIGH SCHOOL**
Played wide receiver and quarterback at Lennard (Ruskin, Fla.) High Schoolâ¦caught 35 passes for 1,017 yards and nine touchdowns as a senior at wide receiver, scoring touchdowns by kickoff returns (three), punt returns (two) and interception-return (one)â¦threw for 988 yards and seven touchdowns in his junior campaignâ¦threw for 430 yards and three touchdowns as a sophomore.
